formula: d ~ 1 + (1 | ArticleID/ExperimentID/cueID/EffectID)
notes: Read deposit anfhm (practice survey filing; the deposit's README and scripts are empty files, the formulas pdf covers the effect-size arithmetic only). Meta-analysis: d is the standardised mean difference, Vd its sampling variance (the metafor V matrix, not a modelled column), EffectID the observation-level random effect. The paper's cueID level has no column in the table, so the cue level is dropped from the grouping list. Model 2 of the filing (adds phylogeny and species) shares the grouping of row 2 and is not a row.

RULE GAP: the raw extraction (MA_dataset_2019_updated.csv) is excluded as the table this one is computed from, although the effect size lives only here.
